% ADDED figure (2026-11-13): one wave packet on a fixed centre; (a) position space, (b) momentum space with the energy shell and the reflected point; generated by qft-C/tools/hw10/figsB/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\tikzset{
  fline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.56 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5.5pt, width=4.5pt]}}}},
  sline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, dash pattern=on 3.5pt off 2.2pt},
  blob/.style={draw, line width=0.8pt, fill=figB!12},
}
\tikzset{
  pline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, decorate, decoration={snake, amplitude=1.6pt, segment length=5.2pt}},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  % ---------- (a) position space ----------
  \begin{scope}
    \draw[->, >=Stealth, line width=0.8pt, black!60] (-4.2,0) -- (3.6,0) node[right, text=black] {$z$};
    \draw[black!60, dashed] (-4.2,1.2) -- (0.2,1.2);
    % the fixed centre and its potential
    \foreach \r/\o in {1.05/10,0.75/18,0.45/28}{\fill[figO!\o] (0,0) circle (\r);}
    \draw[line width=0.8pt, fill=white] (0,0) circle (0.15); \draw[line width=0.8pt] (-0.106,-0.106)--(0.106,0.106) (-0.106,0.106)--(0.106,-0.106);
    \node[font=\scriptsize, align=center] at (0,-1.45) {fixed centre:\\ $A_\mu(\mathbf x)$, no recoil};
    % the incoming packet
    \shade[inner color=figB!80, outer color=white] (-2.9,1.2) ellipse (0.55 and 0.7);
    \foreach \dx in {-0.3,-0.1,0.1,0.3}{\draw[figB!80!black, line width=0.4pt] (-2.9+\dx,0.78) -- (-2.9+\dx,1.62);}
    \draw[->, >=Stealth, line width=1.0pt, figB!80!black] (-2.15,1.2) -- (-1.15,1.2) node[midway, above=1pt] {$\mathbf p_i$};
    \node[font=\scriptsize] at (-2.9,2.2) {packet $\phi(\mathbf k)\,e^{-i\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf k}$};
    \draw[<->, >=Stealth, line width=0.8pt] (-3.9,0) -- (-3.9,1.2); \node[left] at (-3.9,0.6) {$\mathbf b$};
    % the outgoing direction
    \draw[->, >=Stealth, line width=1.0pt, figR] (0.25,0.2) -- (2.2,1.64);
    \node[figR] at (1.25,1.25) {$\mathbf p_f$};
    \draw[figR, line width=0.5pt, rotate around={36.4:(2.45,1.82)}] (2.45,1.82) ellipse (0.16 and 0.42);
    \node[font=\scriptsize, figR] at (3.25,1.95) {$d\Omega$};
    \draw[line width=0.5pt] (1.1,0) arc (0:36.4:1.1); \node at (1.35,0.42) {$\theta$};
    \node at (-0.3,-2.35) {(a) position space};
  \end{scope}
  % ---------- (b) momentum space ----------
  \begin{scope}[xshift=8.9cm]
    \draw[->, >=Stealth, line width=0.8pt, black!60] (-2.6,0) -- (2.75,0) node[right, text=black] {$k^z$};
    \draw[->, >=Stealth, line width=0.8pt, black!60] (0,-2.0) -- (0,2.25) node[above, text=black] {$\mathbf k^\perp$};
    \draw[line width=0.9pt, black!70] (0,0) circle (1.7);
    \node[font=\scriptsize, align=left, black!70] at (2.05,-1.75) {$E_f = E_i$:\\ $|\mathbf p_f| = |\mathbf p_i|$};
    % packet support at p_i and the reflected point
    \shade[inner color=figB!85, outer color=white] (1.7,0) circle (0.34);
    \fill[figB!80!black] (1.7,0) circle (1.3pt); \node[figB!80!black, above right=0pt and -1pt] at (1.78,0.22) {$\mathbf p_i$};
    \draw[figR, dashed, line width=0.7pt] (-1.7,0) circle (0.34);
    \fill[figR] (-1.7,0) circle (1.3pt); \node[figR, font=\scriptsize, align=right, anchor=south east] at (-1.55,0.95) {$\tilde{\mathbf k} = (\mathbf k^\perp, -k^z)$,\\ $\phi(\tilde{\mathbf k}) = 0$};
    \draw[figR, line width=0.4pt] (-1.95,0.95) -- (-1.82,0.36);
    \draw[<->, >=Stealth, line width=0.5pt, black!60] (-1.7,-0.62) -- (1.7,-0.62); \node[font=\scriptsize, black!70, fill=white, inner sep=1pt] at (0,-0.62) {$2|\mathbf p_i|$};
    % final momentum
    \draw[->, >=Stealth, line width=1.0pt, figR] (0,0) -- (36.4:1.7) node[above right=-2pt] {$\mathbf p_f$};
    \draw[line width=0.5pt] (0.7,0) arc (0:36.4:0.7); \node at (0.93,0.27) {$\theta$};
    \node at (0,-2.75) {(b) momentum space};
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
